G001.target_statement: Submit the assignments I have to do for my course through the course's web app (Canvas or Gradescope).
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: 受访者明确说提交作业是课程要求他完成的工作，并描述自己通过 Canvas/Gradescope 提交；主体、对象与条件一致。

G002.target_statement: Submit each assignment before its due date (in time).
G002.label: inferred
G002.rationale: 原文没有‘我希望/必须’式表述，但 T027 描述其一贯做法、T133 明确按时提交个人作业，正面依据足以推断按时提交；未升级为强制流程，也未编造具体时限。
assumptions: 按时提交是对提交动作的限定，且上下文作业需按期完成

G003.target_statement: Before submitting an assignment, open its description and fetch the information needed to do the assignment.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: 原句直接陈述其在提交前先打开作业说明并取用所需信息，动作、对象与顺序一致。

G004.target_statement: Submit a PDF report by uploading the file with the file uploader in Canvas.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: 原句明确给出 PDF 报告这一文件类型下所选的提交方式与应用，主体、对象、条件与方式一致。

G005.target_statement: Submit a code repository by using Gradescope's feature to fetch my latest commit from GitHub and submit my codebase.
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: 原句明确说明代码库提交时使用 Gradescope 抓取 GitHub 最新提交的方式，条件与所选方式一致。

G006.target_statement: Have coding projects auto-graded by the app, because that is very convenient for coding projects.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: 原文把自动评分作为 Gradescope 优于另一应用的功能并明确评价‘very convenient for the coding projects’，正面表达其看重该能力。

G007.target_statement: Know my grade immediately after submitting a code assignment, while taking it as not the final grade.
G007.label: inferred
G007.rationale: 原文未出现‘我希望立刻知道成绩’的表述，只把立即出分作为该提交方式的结果，结合对自动评分的正面评价推断其希望立即得知成绩；‘非最终成绩’限定已保留。
assumptions: 其反复采用该流程代表认可并期待立即出分

G008.target_statement: See my grade for the assignment on the assignment page after it has been graded.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: 原句直接陈述评分后可在作业页看到成绩，主体、对象与触发条件一致。

G009.target_statement: Get feedback in the form of a document with comments after the assignment is graded, so I can see in detail where I can improve.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: 原句明确说明反馈以带批注文档形式给出，并直接说明目的是获得改进位置的详细信息；方式与目的均来自原文。

G010.target_statement: See the feedback comments while viewing my submitted assignment in the document viewer.
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: 原句直接陈述其在查看已提交作业时能看到批注，主体、对象与情境一致。

G011.target_statement: Have feedback comments attached to the specific place in the assignment they refer to, instead of being inserted only in a global part.
G011.label: inferred
G011.rationale: 目标状态由障碍陈述（反馈与作业脱节、需要费力定位）及其归因推断而来，原文未直接提出‘评论应绑定到位置’的要求；未把教师的熟悉程度当作已证事实。
assumptions: 位置绑定可解决其所描述的定位困难

G012.target_statement: Submit a regrade request in Gradescope when I think a comment is wrong or not applicable to my assignment and I should not lose a point there.
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: 原句明确说明其在该情形下会提交 regrade 请求及触发条件与目的（不应被扣分），主体与情境一致。

G013.target_statement: Have a regrade-request feature in Canvas too, so I do not have to fall back on email or other communication tools to contest a grade.
G013.label: inferred
G013.rationale: 原文只说明 Canvas 缺失该功能及带来的不便与放弃行为，未直接提出‘Canvas 也应有该功能’；依据缺失陈述与不便评价推断该诉求。
assumptions: 同一类 regrade 功能适用于 Canvas 的评分场景

G014.target_statement: Contact the professor about a grading problem through a convenient messaging tool such as a Slack channel or DM, rather than email.
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: 原句明确评价 Slack 频道/私信‘very convenient’并说明没有便捷工具时只能用邮件，偏好方向与条件均来自原文；未把偏好写成强制要求。

G015.target_statement: See a detailed per-part grading breakdown (subgrades) through the rubric feature in Canvas.
G015.label: direct
G015.rationale: 原句直接说明其使用 rubric 功能查看各部分子成绩与评分分解，主体、对象与应用条件一致。

G016.target_statement: See a real-time estimated grade for my previously submitted and graded assignments in Canvas.
G016.label: direct
G016.rationale: 原句直接说明其在 Canvas 查看已提交并已评分作业的实时预估成绩，对象与范围一致。

G017.target_statement: Decide how much time to spend on a course using the estimated-grade / indirect feedback information.
G017.label: direct
G017.rationale: 原句明确说明该间接反馈用于决定在课程上投入多少时间，用途直接来自原文。

G018.target_statement: Decide whether to try extra credit to boost my grade using the estimated-grade / indirect feedback information.
G018.label: direct
G018.rationale: 原句明确把该反馈与‘是否争取额外学分提分’的决定联系起来，动作与依据一致。

G019.target_statement: Reach the assignment page or grading page by going through the app homepage/dashboard and selecting the course.
G019.label: direct
G019.rationale: 原句直接陈述其从首页/仪表盘选课程再进入作业或评分页的导航路径，步骤与应用条件一致。

G020.target_statement: See the list of assignments I have previously submitted and have not yet submitted, and choose one to look inside.
G020.label: direct
G020.rationale: 原句直接陈述其查看已提交/未提交作业列表并择一查看，对象与动作一致。

G021.target_statement: Use another app when one app does not have enough features, so the needed feature is supported.
G021.label: direct
G021.rationale: 原句明确说明功能不足时需要使用另一个应用来支持该功能，条件与动作一致。

G022.target_statement: When a professor publishes the assignment on a website, get all the details from that website and then submit through the linked app such as Gradescope.
G022.label: direct
G022.rationale: 原句明确说明该情形下需要从教授网站取全部信息再经链接应用提交，条件、动作与顺序一致。

G023.target_statement: Know how much time remains before an assignment is due through the app.
G023.label: insufficient
G023.rationale: 原文仅把剩余时间提示作为 Gradescope 的功能举例，没有‘我希望/需要看到剩余时间’一类表述，也未说明其如何使用该信息；功能存在不等于需求。
unsupported_parts: 缺少‘希望/需要使用剩余时间信息’的意图依据
未说明该信息用于何种决定

G024.target_statement: Pick up the assignment without having to go through the grade page.
G024.label: insufficient
G024.rationale: 原文只说明混用造成困惑这一障碍，未说明期望的解决方式或目标状态；‘不经过成绩页’只是从障碍反推的一种可能补救，不能当作已表达的目标。
unsupported_parts: 期望的改进方式或目标状态原文未说明
是否要求改变作业与成绩页的组织方式未知

G025.target_statement: Review the transcripts of the recorded interview before submitting the individual assignments.
G025.label: direct
G025.rationale: 原句明确说明提交个人作业前需要复核转写稿，动作与顺序直接来自原文。

G026.target_statement: Have the interview session recorded and get it transcribed for the assignment, or failing that hand over the recording.
G026.label: direct
G026.rationale: 原文明确表示需要录音，并给出最坏情况下交录音或请求转写的处理，需求与备选方式均直接陈述。

G027.target_statement: Fill the time I spend biking, driving, cooking and doing other activities with video or music so that I am entertained.
G027.label: direct
G027.rationale: 访谈总结明确把‘在骑行/开车/做饭等时间获得娱乐’作为其目标并被本人确认准确，另有 T136 自述‘trying to fill time like, find good videos’互相印证。

G028.target_statement: Be entertained while exercising (running or on the exercise bike), which can be monotonous.
G028.label: direct
G028.rationale: 原句以‘I want to be able to be entertained’直接表达运动时的娱乐诉求，并给出单调这一原因，情境与强度一致。

G029.target_statement: Watch a video at home while doing other things such as cooking.
G029.label: direct
G029.rationale: 原句直接说明在家做饭等时候也会看视频，情境与动作一致。

G030.target_statement: Not disturb other people at the gym (by using headphones).
G030.label: direct
G030.rationale: 原句以‘I don't want to disturb anyone else at the gym’直接表达避免型诉求，并说明所用方式（耳机）。

G031.target_statement: Listen to music and watch videos on YouTube without ads.
G031.label: inferred
G031.rationale: 原文未直接说‘我不想看到广告’，只陈述其长期持有去广告的付费方案及结果；据此正面推断无广告是其所要的体验，并把付费方案作为条件保留。
assumptions: 长期付费持有该方案反映其对无广告体验的重视

G032.target_statement: Use YouTube as my main app for both watching videos and music.
G032.label: direct
G032.rationale: 原句直接陈述其看视频几乎总用 YouTube 且音乐也用 YouTube，范围与例外（父母家看 Netflix/Hulu）在 context 中保留。

G033.target_statement: Browse the YouTube recommendations screen to find a video that appeals to me.
G033.label: direct
G033.rationale: 原句直接陈述其通常在推荐页浏览若干条以挑出吸引自己的视频，动作、对象与数量描述一致。

G034.target_statement: Keep videos saved in a Watch later list for later viewing.
G034.label: direct
G034.rationale: 原句直接陈述其在 Watch later 中存了一批视频并在需要时前往查看，动作与对象一致。

G035.target_statement: Put a video I want to watch but not right now into my Watch later list.
G035.label: direct
G035.rationale: 原句直接陈述其把当下不想看但想看的视频放入 Watch later，条件与动作一致。

G036.target_statement: Continue watching by clicking the recommendations shown for the current video.
G036.label: direct
G036.rationale: 原句直接陈述其在第一个视频后点击该视频的推荐，条件（想看时）与动作一致。

G037.target_statement: Watch videos that other people recommend to me, especially long-form ones.
G037.label: direct
G037.rationale: 原句直接陈述其观看他人推荐的视频且长视频尤其如此，动作与强调范围一致；‘几乎总是很棒’的信念未作为事实纳入。

G038.target_statement: Choose content that fits how I feel at the moment (demanding content such as hard math only when I am well rested).
G038.label: direct
G038.rationale: 原句直接说明选择取决于当下状态，并给出硬核内容需要休息充分的条件，条件与强度一致。

G039.target_statement: Pick videos about topics I want to learn more about (games, geography, history).
G039.label: direct
G039.rationale: 原句直接说明其会选符合想了解主题的影片，举例作为情境保留而非固化为独立范围。

G040.target_statement: Replay music I listened to recently from the app's history menu.
G040.label: direct
G040.rationale: 原句直接陈述其从菜单历史里点选最近听过的内容再听，动作与对象一致。

G041.target_statement: Search for the specific music or video I want to watch.
G041.label: direct
G041.rationale: 原句直接陈述其搜索想听/想看的音乐，动作与对象一致。

G042.target_statement: Choose a video whose length fills the time I have available (exactly the remaining bike time, otherwise a 10 to 30 minute video as a safe bet).
G042.label: direct
G042.rationale: 原句直接陈述其按可用时长选择片长，并给出默认区间，数量与时间条件一致。

G043.target_statement: Watch longer videos rather than shorts when I am on YouTube.
G043.label: direct
G043.rationale: 原句以‘I really want to like watch a longer video’直接表达对长视频而非短视频（shorts）的偏好及原因。

G044.target_statement: Leave a video after a few minutes if it turns out not to be good.
G044.label: direct
G044.rationale: 原句直接陈述其若发现视频不好就在几分钟后离开，动作与条件一致。

G045.target_statement: Find something to watch when the recommendations do not surface anything I want, by going to Watch later or searching for something I am interested in.
G045.label: direct
G045.rationale: 原句直接陈述推荐无效时的两种补救方式及其用途，条件与替代方式（A 或 B）一并保留，未改写为必须同时采用。

G046.target_statement: Click off a video the app gives me that I do not want.
G046.label: direct
G046.rationale: 原句直接陈述其遇到不想要的推荐视频时会点掉，动作与触发条件一致。

G047.target_statement: Read the comments for a while to see whether a video gets better.
G047.label: direct
G047.rationale: 原句直接陈述其会读一会儿评论以判断视频是否好转，动作与目的均来自原文。

G048.target_statement: Have smarter users in YouTube comments (my biggest wish for YouTube), because commenters are often pretty dumb.
G048.label: direct
G048.rationale: 原句以‘my biggest wish for Youtube is’直接表达该诉求与强度，并说明其作为评论阅读者的立场；未把‘更聪明’量化为具体标准。

G049.target_statement: Maybe require some sort of basic test (an IQ-style test or even just any basic test) before people are allowed to comment.
G049.label: direct
G049.rationale: 原句明确提出评论前的筛选测试这一建议方式，并保留‘maybe / just sort of’的建议强度；未把玩笑式补充（酒精测试）固化为方案。

G050.target_statement: Avoid story-like content that depends on having watched the previous episode and requires sustained attention.
G050.label: direct
G050.rationale: 原句以‘I don't really like stories’直接表达回避型诉求并给出原因与适用对象，否定与条件完整保留。

G051.target_statement: Have a bunch of stuff I can watch out of order, in whatever order, or skip, which is better for my attention span.
G051.label: direct
G051.rationale: 原句以‘I'd rather have’直接表达对可乱序/可跳过内容的偏好及原因（注意力），偏好与理由一致。

G052.label: direct
G052.rationale: 原句以‘I want more short stuff, short form stuff’直接表达诉求并关联非虚构内容，方向一致。

G053.target_statement: Get basically an endless stream of heavily algorithmically curated videos.
G053.label: inferred
G053.rationale: 原句以泛指句式描述此类需求，未用第一人称直接提出；结合紧随其后把自己与该描述对上的表述推断为该诉求。
assumptions: 泛指的‘someone who wants’即指其本人

G054.target_statement: Have the quantity and the diversity of videos that I want available on the platform.
G054.label: inferred
G054.rationale: 原句说明 YouTube 具备其想要的数量与多样性，未以‘我希望’提出；依据其对平台的正面比较推断为诉求，未编造具体数量阈值。
assumptions: 数量与多样性是其留在平台的正向理由

G055.target_statement: Find a new thing to watch easily.
G055.label: direct
G055.rationale: 原句直接陈述其很容易找到想看的新内容，作为 YouTube 契合其需求的正向结果；未把‘容易’量化。

G056.target_statement: Have recommendations that reflect my long-standing preferences and watch history.
G056.label: inferred
G056.rationale: 原文是对算法状态的主观判断（‘I think it knows my preferences’），并非明确要求；结合其把它作为找内容容易的原因推断为诉求，未把主观信念当作已验证事实。
assumptions: 对算法的肯定性评价反映其希望推荐继续基于历史偏好

G057.target_statement: Stay on YouTube instead of switching to another streaming platform.
G057.label: direct
G057.rationale: 总结句指出推荐是其不换平台的主因，本人以‘That's a big part of it’确认；仅保留‘是一大原因’这一强度，未声称唯一原因。

G058.target_statement: Download videos in advance when I have good Wi-Fi beforehand, so I have them for a long trip / driving.
G058.label: direct
G058.rationale: 原句直接陈述其在长途出行前借良好 Wi-Fi 预下载视频并边开车边听，条件与动作一致；具体时长含转写噪声，未固化为精确数值。

G059.target_statement: Have downloading videos be easy in the app.
G059.label: direct
G059.rationale: 原句明确评价下载‘really easy’并保留前提（高级版），正向评价与条件一致；未升级为必须提供离线下载。

G060.target_statement: Have the app's content categories divided the way I would subdivide my own interests (a few music genres, Breaking Bad stuff, board games, math things, video game stuff), so it is easier for me to watch.
G060.label: direct
G060.rationale: 原句明确表达其会按自己的方式划分内容并说明这样更好找，目的与举例均来自原文；举例保留为情境，未固化为必须的分类清单。
